table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname= item.name, 
	saleitemdesc= SRD.returnitemdescription ,
	saleinvcode = SRL.saleinvcode,   
	salecatcode=SRL.srcatcode,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
	accname =dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
	city= dbo.customer.city,   
	licenceno= dbo.customer.licenceno,   
	username= dbo.users.username,   
	srinvcode = SRL.srbufferinvcode,
	fiscalinvoiceno=(select fiscalinvoiceno from srledger where srinvcode=:ar_code),   
	headerno = SRL.headerno, 
	headerinvno=SRL.headerinvno,  
	date = SRL.date,   
	invdiscperc = SRL.discperc,   
	misccharges = SRL.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = SRL.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = SRL.salestax,   
	gcode = SRD.gcode,   
	icode = SRD.icode,   
	batch = SRD.batch,   
	expiry = SRD.expiry,   
	looseqty = SRD.looseqty,   
	bonusqty = SRD.bonusqty,   
	packqty = 0.0000,   
	packunits= SRD.packunits,   
	saleprice= SRD.srprice,   
	discperc = SRD.discperc,   
	salestax = SRD.salestax,  
	itemflatdisc=0.00,   
	Id = SRD.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=SRL.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = SRD.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = SRD.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = SRL.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	SRL.custrefno,	
	custref2=SRL.custrefno2,
	SRL.remarks,
	salesman=ltrim(rtrim(dbo.salesman.name)),
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manfcode=item.manfcode),
	CUSTALIAS=ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME,
	patientname=(select name from patient where patientcode=SRL.patientcode),
	patientaddress=(select address1 from patient where patientcode=SRL.patientcode),
	cashpaid=ISNULL(SRL.amt, 0) + ISNULL(SRL.CashCharged, 0)  + ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Amount),0) FROM MasterCashWin MCW WHERE MCW.DocumentType = 'SR' AND MCW.DocumentCode = SRL.SRBufferInvCode), 0),
	godown=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=SRD.gcode),
	PackCapacity = item.PackCapacity,
	AreaVolume = item.AreaVolume,
	PCS=ROUND(SRD.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume IS NULL OR item.AreaVolume <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE item.AreaVolume END, 6),
	Cartons= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CAST(((ROUND(SRD.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6)) / CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END) AS INT), 7, 0))) + ' : ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(((CAST(ROUND(SRD.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6) AS INT)) % CAST(CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END AS INT)), 7, 0)))
FROM 
	SRBufferLedger SRL
	LEFT OUTER JOIN SalesMan ON (SRL.smancode = dbo.salesman.salesmancode),
	SRBufferDetail SRD,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item 
WHERE 
	( SRL.srbufferinvcode = :ar_code ) AND
	( SRL.srbufferinvcode=SRD.srbufferinvcode) AND
	( SRL.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( SRL.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( SRD.icode = dbo.item.icode)
ORDER BY 
	SRD.srbufferinvcode,
	godown,
	SRD.IDENTITYCOL
